Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class SearchPromptAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.SearchPromptAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
SearchPromptPort
@Component public class SearchPromptAdapter extends Object implements SearchPromptPort
JPA-backed implementation of SearchPromptPort.

Maps between the immutable SearchPromptConfig domain record and the mutable SearchPromptEntity JPA entity. The save operation is an upsert — if an entity with the given engine key already exists it is updated in place; otherwise a new row is inserted.

Domain objects never hold references to JPA entities — the mapping methods toDomain(com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.SearchPromptEntity) and the inline entity construction in save(com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.SearchPromptConfig) ensure the two representations stay isolated.
